name: frontmatter_invalid
description: Document is missing valid YAML frontmatter or required title/type fields.
fix_hint: Add valid YAML frontmatter from templates/.

name: contract_unresolved
description: Declared contract entry could not be resolved against tracked project source.
fix_hint: Update contract id/kind, enable the needed extension in pylons.yaml, or mark pending: true on package exposes.

name: orphan_document
description: Document has no incoming markdown or frontmatter link.
fix_hint: Link the document from a package, plan, or index.

name: unlinked_domain_term
description: Domain entity term is mentioned without linking to domain/entities/.
fix_hint: Link the first mention to the entity document.

name: ste100_violation
description: Sentence exceeds ASD-STE100 maximum length (25 words descriptive).
fix_hint: Split long sentences into short active-voice statements.

name: status_folder_mismatch
description: Document status does not match its folder.
fix_hint: Move the document to the folder matching its status or update status:.

name: unknown_status
description: Document status is outside the closed vocabulary for its root folder.
fix_hint: Use an allowed status from manifests/vocabulary.json.

name: shipped_plan_no_artifact
description: Shipped plan must declare a non-empty artifact:.
fix_hint: Set artifact: to the shipping PR, commit, or file path.

name: accepted_decision_unnumbered
description: Accepted decision must use a numbered DNNNN-slug.md filename.
fix_hint: Rename the file to DNNNN-<slug>.md.

name: move_target_collision
description: Archive destination already exists for terminal plan.
fix_hint: Resolve or remove the duplicate archive file.

name: broken_internal_link
description: Markdown link points to a missing local document.
fix_hint: Fix or remove the broken relative markdown link.

name: dependency_violation
description: Package depends_on references an unknown package.
fix_hint: Add the missing package map or fix depends_on:.

name: contract_falsifier
description: Accepted or in-progress plan contract.stable entry is missing wrong_if:.
fix_hint: Add wrong_if: describing what invalidates the contract.

name: stale_documentation
description: Document updated: date trails recent changes.
fix_hint: Review and bump updated:.

name: accepted_plan_missing_evidence
description: Accepted plan must cite at least one ticket: entry.
fix_hint: Add ticket: metadata to the plan frontmatter.

name: audit_finding_row_invalid
description: Audit findings table row has an unrecognized status.
fix_hint: Use open, fixed, rejected, or moved.

name: supersession_link_broken
description: Document supersedes: target does not exist.
fix_hint: Fix the superseded path or slug.

name: proposal_frontmatter_invalid
description: Plan or proposal lacks valid frontmatter fields.
fix_hint: Ensure title, type: plan, and status are set.

name: proposal_section_missing
description: Plan or proposal is missing a required section heading.
fix_hint: Add ## Problem, ## Design, and ## Milestones.

name: postmortem_section_missing
description: Quirk post-mortem is missing a required section heading.
fix_hint: Add ## Symptom, ## Cause, and ## Resolution.

name: pending_contract_resolved
description: Pending package exposes entry already resolves in code.
fix_hint: Remove pending: true from the exposes entry.

name: postmortem_source_not_found
description: Quirk sources: entry does not exist on disk.
fix_hint: Fix or remove the missing source path.

name: reaudit_overdue
description: Active audit reaudit: date is in the past.
fix_hint: Run a new audit or update reaudit:.

name: in_progress_plan_no_trace
description: In-progress plan has no artifact: and no matching branch.
fix_hint: Create a feature branch or set artifact:.

name: quirk_guard
description: Quirk guard: is invalid or missing after 30 days.
fix_hint: Set guard: to lint-rule, convention, test, or accepted-risk.

name: protected_glob
description: Protected path entry is malformed or matches a queried edit target.
fix_hint: Ensure each protected entry has glob, owner, and reason.

name: investigation_filename_invalid
description: Investigation filename must match YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md.
fix_hint: Rename the investigation file to YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md.

name: investigation_closure_invalid
description: Closed investigation must include ## Root Cause and ## Resolution.
fix_hint: Add ## Root Cause and ## Resolution sections.

name: inert_contract_glob
description: Plan editing or unstable glob matches zero files.
fix_hint: Fix or remove the inert glob pattern.

name: path_mention_style
description: Document contains a raw machine path instead of repo:// or pylon:// URI.
fix_hint: Replace machine paths with repo://<alias>/<path> or pylon://<path>.

name: folder_entry_agents
description: Zone folder has documents but no AGENTS.md entry point.
fix_hint: Add an AGENTS.md guide in the zone folder.

name: contract_verified_by
description: Contract verified_by: or falsified_by: test symbol did not resolve.
fix_hint: Update the test file::symbol reference.

name: quirk_contract
description: Quirk contracts: entry is missing kind or id.
fix_hint: Specify both kind and id on each quirk contract.

name: stale_branch_mention
description: Branch qualifier in repo://alias@branch/ does not exist locally.
fix_hint: Update or remove the stale branch qualifier.

name: plan_filename_invalid
description: Plan or proposal filename must start with a valid type prefix.
fix_hint: Prefix filename with feature-, refactor-, chore-, docs-, or perf-.

name: term_no_avoid
description: Domain entity declares no avoid: anti-terms.
fix_hint: Add avoid: entries naming the wrong near-synonyms beside the term.

name: contract_unproven
description: Provable contract entry carries no verified_by: or falsified_by: proof pointer.
fix_hint: Add verified_by: naming the table test or QA check that proves the contract.

name: postmortem_field_token
description: Post-mortem field uses a token outside its closed vocabulary.
fix_hint: Use an allowed token from manifests/vocabulary.json.

name: ratchet_regression
description: Advisory count for a package or zone rose above the committed baseline.
fix_hint: Fix the new advisories, or re-baseline with pylon review ratchet --update after review.

name: import_undeclared
description: A file imports another registered project the owning package does not declare in depends_on.
fix_hint: Declare the dependency in depends_on: or remove the import.

name: ripple_open
description: The target surface is referenced by other ledger artifacts that must move in the same change.
fix_hint: Update the listed artifacts in the same session, or accept the stale neighbors knowingly.

name: slice_incomplete
description: A slice plan lacks a behavior contract or the test surface that proves it.
fix_hint: Declare contracts on every layer the slice touches: behavior plus a test file or glob.

name: contract_no_scenario
description: A slice plan's behavior contract has no covering declared scenario.
fix_hint: Add a scenario entry with given/when/expect and covers naming the contract id.

name: merge_danger
description: The pull request body lacks a valid merge danger line, or the derived minimum door outranks the author door.
fix_hint: Keep exactly one 'Merge danger: <one-way|two-way> | blast radius: <scope>' line; a one-way door needs a release marker or a 'Data migration:' note.

name: release_surface
description: A pinned deployment consumes a public surface that is removed or changed against the pinned release tag, or a pin cannot be judged.
fix_hint: Restore the surface at HEAD or cut and ship a new release for the pinned deployment; unregistered pins fail closed.

name: parity_not_evaluated
description: A parity declaration has one half without the other, or the declared enum cannot be resolved; a skipped set must never read as parity.
fix_hint: Declare states and states_symbol together, and point states_symbol at a repo:// file and enum name that exists.

name: parity_count_mismatch
description: The declared state count differs from the code enum's case count.
fix_hint: Align the states list with the enum's cases in the same change.

name: parity_state_mismatch
description: A state token appears on only one side of the declared-vs-code comparison.
fix_hint: Align the states list with the enum's cases in the same change.

name: parity_route_mismatch
description: No source line in the mapped project mentions the declared route path.
fix_hint: Register the route in the mapped project, or drop the expose entry.

name: transition_unparseable
description: A declared machine cannot be fully resolved: the declaration is malformed or the code map cannot be extracted.
fix_hint: Fix the declaration shape or the code-side map so both sides resolve fully.

name: transition_mismatch
description: The declared and extracted transition triple sets differ.
fix_hint: Align the declared triples with the code map in the same change.

name: unknown_state_in_triple
description: A declared triple names a state outside the machine's declared state set.
fix_hint: Add the state to the machine's states list, or fix the triple.

name: unreachable_state
description: A declared state is neither initial nor reachable from the initial states.
fix_hint: Add a path from the initial states, or drop the state.

name: dead_state
description: A declared state has no outgoing transitions and is not terminal.
fix_hint: Declare the state terminal, or give it an outgoing transition.

name: duplicate_transition
description: The same from-event pair is declared twice on one side.
fix_hint: Remove the duplicate triple from the declaration or the code map.

name: bypassed_state_write
description: The machine's persisted state key is written outside the machine surface.
fix_hint: Route the write through the machine's transition function, or declare the writer part of the surface.

name: secret_shape
description: A provider-shaped credential appears in a ledger document.
fix_hint: Rotate the credential; deleting the line does not remove it from git history. A quoted example key takes the pylons-allow-secret line marker.

name: secret_assignment
description: A line looks like an assigned secret value.
fix_hint: Rotate it if real, or reword the example so it cannot read as a live value.

name: gate_surface_changed
description: The diff touches a surface the checker itself relies on.
fix_hint: Revert or walk the change through the ledger owners; gate surfaces decide what the checker may silence.

name: gate_surface_not_evaluated
description: The gate surface check could not run against the requested base.
fix_hint: Pin --base to a reachable ref so the check can run.

name: frontmatter_unknown_key
description: The frontmatter carries keys no check reads for this doc type.
fix_hint: Remove the key or declare it in the type's template; no check reads it.

name: paused_plan_no_state
description: Paused plan carries no ## State section.
fix_hint: Add ## State naming the resume point: what is done, the next step, and any blocker.
